findings.current: The compensation for the month-long war was such an astronomical sum that anything I earned from it could be treated as pocket change.
findings.defect: The comparison is reversed. The fifty-trillion bounty is the astronomical sum, while his separate compensation for the month-long war is what would look like pocket change beside it.
findings.rationale: The subject of 천문학적인 금액 is the bounty established in the preceding sentence, and 전쟁으로 얻게 될 보수 is explicitly the lesser amount.
findings.replacement: The bounty was so astronomical that the compensation I would receive for the month-long war would look like pocket change by comparison.
findings.source:
깜빡 잊고 있던 사실이었지만, 아크 리치의 목에 걸린 현상금은 무려 50조였다.

한 달가량 이어진 전쟁으로 얻게 될 보수는 거스름돈 취급해도 될 만큼 천문학적인 금액.

findings.defect: The two relatives are given visibly different surnames even though the reveal depends on their surnames being identical.
findings.rationale: Both names use 샤오, and Taekyung recognizes the shared surname immediately before learning that Shao Shen is Chairman Shao Yang’s grandson.

findings.current: Magic Johnson, who had watched the entire scene, clicked his tongue.
findings.defect: The physical action and its implication are reversed. Clicking one’s tongue suggests disapproval, whereas 입맛을 다셨다 means he smacked his lips, matching his attraction to Felix.
findings.rationale: The lip-smacking directly sets up his next line, “Charming,” and the ensuing exchange about his tastes.
findings.replacement: Magic Johnson, who had watched the entire scene, smacked his lips.
findings.source: 이 모든 광경을 지켜보던 매직 존슨이 입맛을 다셨다.

findings.current: “I have shown you respect. It shall never happen again, so consider it an honor to be remembered by your descendants. Until next time.”
findings.defect: The descendants are assigned the wrong role. Felix says Taekyung should regard the event as an honor for generations to come, not that Taekyung will be remembered by his descendants.
findings.rationale: 대대손손 modifies how long the honor should be cherished; it does not say the descendants will remember Taekyung himself.
findings.replacement: “I have shown you respect. It shall never happen again, so let your family treasure the honor for generations to come. Until next time.”
findings.source: 「경의를 표한 것이다. 두 번 다시 없을 일이니 대대손손 영광으로 여기도록. 그럼 다음에 보도록 하지.」

findings.current: *The Case of My Acquaintance’s Younger Brother in China Turning Out to Be the Chinese Chairman’s Grandson.*
findings.defect: The title changes the relationship. 아는 동생 is a younger friend or junior Taekyung knows, not the younger brother of an acquaintance.
findings.rationale: Shao Shen himself is the younger acquaintance whom Taekyung met in China.
findings.replacement: *The Younger Friend I Made in China Turned Out to Be the Chinese Chairman’s Grandson.*
findings.source: 이거 무슨 소설인가. ‘중국에서 만난 아는 동생이 중국 주석 손자였던 건에 대하여.’ 제목도 비현실적이다.

findings.current: For the first time, I felt as though I had returned to my place.
findings.defect: 비로소 means “finally,” not “for the first time.” The current wording incorrectly implies that Taekyung has never previously felt at home with these people.
findings.rationale: The beat marks his return to a familiar sense of belonging after the ordeal, not the first occurrence of that feeling.
findings.replacement: It finally felt like I was back where I belonged.
findings.source: 한 대 쥐어박으려다가 피식 실소가 터져 나왔다. 비로소 내 자리로 돌아온 것 같아서였다.

findings.current: “Keep your chin up. I’ll ask Mr. Johnson to take a look next time.”
findings.defect: The translation makes the euphemistic request more explicit by implying a physical or medical examination. The source only says Choi will ask Johnson for help.
findings.rationale: 잘 부탁해 보겠습니다 preserves the indirect comic euphemism and does not specify that Johnson will examine anything.
findings.replacement: “Keep your chin up. I’ll ask Mr. Johnson nicely next time.”
findings.source: “힘내십시오. 다음에 미스터 존슨에게 잘 부탁해 보겠습니다.”

findings.current: “It does not stand? I am an eunuch?”
findings.defect: The questions weaken the Skeleton King’s anguished assertions, and “an eunuch” is ungrammatical. The source uses the established euphemism 서다 and an emphatic lament.
findings.rationale: The source presents both clauses as despairing realizations rather than requests for confirmation.

findings.current: They say China is too large to be called a small nation, yet too narrow-minded to be called a Great Nation, but this old man was something else.
findings.defect: The rendering drops the 소국–대국–중국 wordplay and replaces 롸끈하시다, which praises the Chairman’s bold generosity, with the vague phrase “something else.”
findings.rationale: 중국 literally supplies the joke’s middle term, while 롸끈하시다 is a playful pronunciation conveying that the Chairman is impressively freehanded.
findings.replacement: They say China is the Middle Kingdom because it’s too large to be a small nation and too narrow-minded to be a Great Nation, but this old man was damn generous.
findings.source: 소국이라 하기에는 너무 크고, 대국이라 하기에는 속이 너무 좁아서 중국이라더니 이 할배는 아주 롸끈하시다.

findings.current: That was the first thing Team Leader Choi said after stepping off the aircraft.
findings.defect: The draft omits that Team Leader Choi was the first person to disembark.
findings.rationale: 가장 먼저 내린 explicitly establishes his order of disembarkation, separately from 처음으로 건넨 말.
findings.replacement: That was the first thing Team Leader Choi, the first to step off the aircraft, said to me.
findings.source: 항공기에서 가장 먼저 내린 최 팀장이 처음으로 건넨 말이었다.

findings.current: “Please give me some warning before you turn on me.”
findings.defect: The current line loses the turn-signal and cutting-in metaphor that carries the joke.
findings.rationale: 깜빡이 좀 켜고 들어오다 humorously likens Choi’s abrupt tonal swerve to a driver cutting into traffic without signaling.
findings.replacement: “Please use your turn signal before cutting in like that.”

findings.current: “That brat was the one who insulted me the most, right?”
findings.defect: “Insulted me” suggests direct insults addressed to Taekyung, while 욕 제일 많이 했다 means Hayeon badmouthed or talked the most trash about him with the others.
findings.rationale: Choi’s answer confirms that Hayeon was egging their mother on in Taekyung’s absence rather than confronting him directly.
findings.replacement: “That brat badmouthed me the most, right?”
findings.source: “저 녀석이 제 욕 제일 많이 했죠?”

findings.current: A country’s size must be proportional to the size of its liver.
findings.defect: The literal “size of its liver” is opaque and unnatural in English, obscuring the Korean idiom connecting a large liver with audacity or gall.
findings.rationale: 간이 크다 describes extraordinary nerve or brazenness; 국토 면적 supplies the parallel measure of physical size.
findings.replacement: A country’s landmass must be proportional to its people’s nerve.
findings.source: 국토 면적과 간의 크기가 비례하는 것이 틀림없다.

summary: Multiple actionable fidelity errors alter a quantity comparison, the family-name reveal, physical actions, kinship, and several jokes or pragmatic cues.
